'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Paul Bonsall DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bonsall]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Kessel CR(V). Typed Holotable 'Dark - Kessel CR(V)'; handwritten 'Paul Bonsall Worlds'. No Objective heading. (1 starting): I'll Take Them Myself, Gift Of The Master, Ni Chuba Na?? (V), Knowledge And Defense (V), Combat Readiness (V), Kessel: Spice Mines - Administrator's Office, Kessel, plus all 15 shields. Force Field (V) (x2) is the first line of page 2 (interrupt continuation). Reserve qty 60 excluding Defensive shield.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|I'll Take Them Myself|VB7-D-illtakethemmyself-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
